title: Understanding the Hat Matrix
text: The hat matrix $H$ is used in linear regression to project the observed values $Y$ onto the space spanned by the columns of $X$. It is defined as $H=X(X**TX)**{-1}X**T$.

title: Properties of the Hat Matrix
text: The hat matrix $H$ is symmetric and idempotent. This means $H=H**T$ and $H**2=H$.

title: Orthogonality of $$\$(I-H)Y\$$$
text: The vector $$\$(I-H)Y\$$$ is orthogonal to the column space of $X$. This is because $H$ projects $Y$ onto the column space of $X$, and $$\$(I-H)\$$$ projects $Y$ onto the orthogonal complement of the column space of $X$.

title: Checking Orthogonality
text: To check if $$\$(I-H)Y\$$$ is orthogonal to the column space of $X$, consider the product $X**T(I-H)Y$. What should this product equal if $$\$(I-H)Y\$$$ is orthogonal to the column space of $X$?
